title: Loneliness to Purpose
subtitle: A cross-linked bridge between two recurring pressures
description: Guru joins belonging to remembrance, Sangat, and the nearness of the One. This bridge then carries into guru frames human life as opportunity for meeting, service, and naam rather than mere maintenance.

heroSource.shortMeaning: The Guru is named as protector, mother, and father.
heroSource.lifeApplication: Bring loneliness and dependence into prayer without embarrassment.
